items.title: LCP highlights workplace pensions as key employer priority
items.summary: A new report from consultancy LCP examines key considerations and opportunities for UK pension schemes as workplace pensions undergo a period of change.

items.title: The Fidelis Partnership appoints Rebecca Matts as Head of Corporate Affairs
items.summary: Rebecca Matts joins the Bermuda-based managing general underwriter in a newly created senior leadership role, reporting to Group CFO Conor O’Riordan.

items.title: Gallagher highlights limitations in cyber cover for non-IT supplier failures
items.summary: Narrow policy definitions and capped supplier contracts can leave businesses exposed when third parties such as delivery firms and warehouses suffer cyber incidents.

items.title: UK passive equity funds record first net outflows in three years
items.summary: UK marketed passive equity funds experienced net withdrawals in November for the first time since August 2023.

items.title: Zurich UK launches life insurance advertising campaign focused on life milestones
items.summary: Zurich UK has initiated a multi-channel advertising campaign designed to reframe life protection around life milestones rather than the end of life.

items.title: Allianz Commercial plans direct underwriting syndicate at Lloyd’s for 2027
items.summary: Allianz Commercial has announced plans to launch a direct underwriting syndicate at Lloyd’s, targeting specialty and MGA business from January subject to final approval.
